summary: The Fracture Depths lie beneath the floating shards of the Shattered Expanse. Dimensional shockwaves carved caverns, tunnels, and void pockets into the broken earth. War‑Shades and Discord entities gather here, drawn to the unstable energy that pulses through the depths.
history: The Depths formed during the First Fracture when Discord energy ruptured the plains.
Floating shards collapsed inward, creating caverns and dimensional pockets.
War‑Shades began manifesting in the depths, feeding on fracture energy.
Riftseekers attempted to stabilize the caverns but failed.
The Depths became a battleground for Discord‑forged entities seeking control.
